prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1034; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had been waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic and had my turn signal on. The impact threw me against the driver's side door, and I felt a sharp pain in my left wrist right away. I was taken to the hospital, where an X-ray confirmed a fracture and I was placed in a cast. I have given the same account of what happened to the officer at the scene, to the medical staff, and to the claims representative, and I have nothing to add or change. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating my own vehicle at the time. I am willing to provide any further documents needed to process this claim.
